title: Chip family
description: config/chips/<producer>/<family>.yml: one chip family of one producer — its chips, and the toolchains that build for them (a chip may name its own). The file is named after the family's id; its directory groups the producer's families (and the boards under config/boards/ mirror it).

id.description: Unique across producers (the programmers name families by it)

name.description: The family as the vendor names it (Quartus' FAMILY, Efinity's family)

default_toolchains.description: Toolchains every chip of the family builds with, as <toolchain>[<version constraint>]

id.description: The part number as the vendor writes it

toolchains.description: This chip's toolchains when they differ from the family's
